beats.composition_summary: Full-bleed crayon-style airplane cabin viewed diagonally down the aisle. A jagged broken window dominates the right side with clouds visible through the opening. Curved blue-green airflow streaks cross the cabin from the window toward the left. Multiple oxygen masks hang from the overhead panels. A masked woman sits on the left and a masked man sits in the foreground right, oriented toward the damaged-window side.

targets.label: jagged broken right-side airplane window
targets.visible_evidence: Large jagged-edged window opening on the right with blue sky and clouds visible through it.

targets.label: curved airflow streaks crossing cabin
targets.visible_evidence: Multiple blue and green curved bands visibly sweep leftward across the seats and windows from the broken-window area.

targets.label: hanging oxygen mask group
targets.visible_evidence: Several orange mask bags with attached pale masks hang from overhead panels across the cabin.

targets.label: foreground seated man's masked face
targets.visible_evidence: A brown-haired man's profile is visible above the foreground right seat with a pale covering over his lower face; he faces screen right toward the window.

targets.label: left seated woman's masked face
targets.visible_evidence: Dark-haired seated woman at left has a pale mask covering her mouth and nose.

targets.label: seated woman's visible hand at armrest
targets.visible_evidence: One hand is visibly resting beside the seated woman's armrest.

beats.notes: Preserve the broken window, airflow bands and hanging masks together when cropping. The foreground man's screen-right orientation visually points toward the damaged window. Avoid obscuring the two visible faces.

beats.composition_summary: Full-bleed crayon-style airplane cabin with no people visible. Empty tan seats occupy the lower half, overhead bins span the top, and several deployed oxygen masks hang from the ceiling panels. Clouds are visible through the right-side windows. One middle-right window contains a small star-like crack beside a circular swirl mark.

targets.label: small crack on middle-right window
targets.visible_evidence: A small dark star-shaped crack is visibly drawn on the pane of the middle-right window beside a spiral-like mark.

targets.label: deployed hanging oxygen masks
targets.visible_evidence: Multiple orange mask bags and attached pale masks hang at different depths beneath the overhead panels.

targets.label: empty passenger seat rows
targets.visible_evidence: Several unoccupied tan passenger seats and armrests fill the lower and middle cabin.

targets.label: cloud layer visible through cabin windows
targets.visible_evidence: White cloud forms are visibly framed by several right-side windows.

beats.notes: No people or hands are visible. The small cracked-window detail is much smaller than the mask group, so a crop should not remove the middle-right window if that detail is meant to remain readable.

beats.composition_summary: Crayon-style airplane cabin scene occupying the upper roughly seven-eighths of the frame, with a pale blank caption/card area across the bottom. A jagged broken window glows on the right, blue-green airflow streaks sweep leftward across the cabin, loose paper pieces appear near the opening, and oxygen masks hang farther back. Several passengers are visible; a woman near center-left visibly holds a green oxygen mask to her face, while other passengers look forward or toward the damaged-window side.

The pale lower panel beginning around 0.88 image height is visibly blank and should remain excluded from artwork-driven targeting.
